About Optimum Engineers Ltd.

Optimum Engineers Limited (OEL in short) is established in July 2019 by a group of highly experienced Engineers in the field of industrial Electrical Systems, Fire Safety, and overall MEP (Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing) solutions.

Soon after its inception, OEL has established itself as one of the market leaders in fire fighting and industrial safety solutions. At present, OEL is providing turnkey solutions for both industrial and commercial projects offering Engineering Assessment, Design & Consultancy, Installation & Testing, and Commissioning & also Annual Maintenance Contracts in the field of Fire Safety, Electrical Safety, Other Mechanical Services & Automation Solutions.

The Principal Tenets of OEL are Integrity, Professionalism, Affordable Products & Timely Delivery. Our main aim is to ensure full satisfaction of our honorable clients and hence OEL is always looking forward to giving superior customer service by providing the latest technology and engineering solutions.

OEL has a strong team comprising of NFPA Certified Fire Detection Engineer & Protection Engineer, ABC Supervisor Licensed Electrical Engineers, highly experienced designer and technicians which allow us to work in multiple business fields from Industries to Medical Sectors to Commercial and Residential Projects all at the same time. Moreover, we are connected to numerous Global Leading Manufacturers which allows us to provide the best products available in the market to our customers. Our aim is to establish a long-term business relationship with all of our valuable clients and also our vendors and hence we strictly follow business integrity and professionalism.

OEL is also committed to ensuring no harm is being done to any humans (our employees and everyone else), animals, and the environment by any of our activities, and Health, Safety, and Environment is also one of our primary focuses.

OEL Business Philosophy

“To provide the best Engineering Solutions at an economic and feasible budget, ensuring both full satisfaction of our valuable client & no harm to any people and animals and environment is OEL’s primary Business Philosophy”

VISION

OEL is founded with a vision to become a premium engineering organization not only within the borders of Bangladesh but around the globe. Our dream is to deliver our projects following all the Engineering Ethics and Norms & achieve the full satisfaction of our customers. Our
commitment is to provide sustainable solutions following the green engineering concept.

We also have the vision to build a career path for our own people (employees) where we will ensure their complete safety and workplace satisfaction providing each and everyone a fair return on the value we deliver.

We uphold the values of the Engineering Association and are vigilant to the values of the communities and businesses we are partnered with.

MISSION

OEL’s primary mission – “Deliver Projects on-time & within a given budget, guaranteeing the performance & ensuring fulfillment of customers’ requirements.”To achieve our mission, OEL is constantly updating with the latest technologies, codes, and standards in all related industries we are operating. OEL is always upgrading and enhancing the capabilities of its Team Members to provide the best economic solutions to our honorable clients. As a self-learning company, OEL is developing every day to provide a better, cost-cutting, energy-saving, and environment-friendly system and solution to our customers.

OUR MOTTO

Core Engineering Solution and Latest Technology for Better Tomorrow world.

OEL Strength

OEL is founded by Engineers and in all key positions, we have highly experienced Engineers working dedicatedly. As a result, knowledge is our Key Strength.

Engineering Assessment

OEL has a dedicated team of highly trained Engineers, who have very good knowledge of NFPA and BNBC, and other International Standards and Codes, At OEL, we do both Assessments of existing Projects to determine how much it complies with the codes and standards and also when a new project comes in our pipeline, we at first carry out an assessment to determine the exact requirements so that we can provide the best solutions to our clients.

Engineering Consultancy

At OEL, we do Consultancy of kind of Mechanical, Electrical and Fire related works. We have industry experienced Engineers, NFPA certified Engineers to design the system as per the requirements of our customers. Engineering Consultancy involves designing and drawing of the system (As-Built or Proposed), preparing BOQ (Bill of Quantities) of Materials required, and proposing solutions to the problems of our clients.

Supply, Erection, Testing & Commissioning

OEL is connected with renowned Manufacturers across the globe, from the US to UAE to Europe to China. Hence, we can always provide our clients with the best products available in the market at an affordable
rate. We have our own team of Engineers and Technicians to carry out all kinds of erection works – from Cable Conduit Work to Mechanical fabrication, equipment installation. We carry out Testing and Commissioning of the Systems as per NFPA and BNBC guidelines along with full documentation, i.e. drawings and standard reports.

Schedule Maintenance

At OEL, we have a separate team to carry out Scheduled Maintenance and hence many companies are relying on us and do Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) with us. All scheduled maintenance work is carried out in collaboration with the client’s Engineering Team. We also provide services during the breakdown period as per the instruction of our customers.

OEL has Engineering currently doing a Ph.D. In BUET, multiple Graduate Engineers (Masters) and all Bachelor passed Engineers along with a group of very experienced honorable Faculty Members as our advisors – OEL believes this is our biggest strength: KNOWLEDGE AND INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE.

THE MANAGEMENT IS COMMITTED TO

  • Develop and improve the Quality Management System
  • Continually improve the effectiveness of the Quality Management System
  • The enhancement of Customer Satisfaction

WE ALSO HAVE A CONTINUING COMMITMENT TO:

  • Ensure that customer needs and expectations are determined and fulfilled with the aim of achieving a consistently high level of Customer Satisfaction
  • Communicate throughout the Company the importance of meeting customer needs and Legal Requirements
  • Establish the Quality Policy and its Objectives
  • Conduct Management Reviews on the effectiveness of the implementation of the Quality Management System
  • Ensure the Availability of Resources

All personnel is suitably qualified and experienced, understand the requirements of our QUALITY POLICY, and abide by the contents of the Quality Manual. The Quality Policy is regularly reviewed in order to ensure its continuing suitability.

A Massage From Chairman

We formed Optimum Engineers Limited (OEL) along with a group of experienced Engineers, our fellow friends, who are expertized in their respective fields. OEL is formed as a core Engineering Solution Company with a view of “something new, something different”. I am very proudly saying that OEL has already successfully established its name and created a strong position in the local market. In the upcoming days, we promise to continue delivering better economic solutions and products having higher quality performance to our respected clients. In the forthcoming days, our Engineering Division will keep on implementing strategies and different methodologies to ensure higher quality and efficiency. In Project Division, we strive to achieve strategic planning with demand trends and cost reductions through the establishment of systematic work and the visualization of cost by each activity.I believe as a true Engineering Company, OEL, can provide you with the best Engineering solutions available in the current market.

A Massage From Managing Director

 

I believe our quality of service, efficiency, and customer care distinguish OEL from others currently operating in the market. Our journey to industrial safety and security to MEP and Automation has been the result of our continuous achievements & recognitions in the current market. The ambition of becoming the best in the market is actually motivating us to accelerate, giving us the power to offer and implement solutions that are not available / in practice in the Bangladesh market. We have a solid engineering foundation, which is constantly helping us to offer out-of-box solutions to our happy clients. We at OEL constantly endeavor to offer our customers, clients, and stakeholders a bouquet of security and success. We value our clients a lot and always try to provide the best customer service possible. Our own people, team members, stakeholders, and business partners, everyone together forms OEL and we strongly believe in long-term relationships. Lastly, at OEL, while we are designing a solution for our clients, we always try to provide sustainable, environment-friendly, energy-saving solutions and we always ensure animal safety. We at OEL constantly endeavor to offer our customers, clients and shareholders, a bouquet of security & success. I can assure you that we shall leave no stone unturned in striving to be the best, to relentlessly augment each and every sphere of fire protection while keeping the demands of our environment at its core, so as to make our world a better place to live in for each one of us and the future generations to come.

product/stand-pipe.title: Stand Pipe
product/stand-pipe.content:
Stand Pipe

Fire Hose Pipe

Standpipe systems are a series of pipes which connect a water supply to hose connections, basically an extension of the fire hydrant system. They are designed to provide a pre-piped water system for building occupants or the fire department. Standpipe systems are designed to provide fire protection water for hose lines in strategically placed locations inside a building or structure.

Categories: Fire Safety, Stand Pipe, Standpipe & Hose Pipe

Description

There are three classes of standpipe systems:

Class I – A Class I standpipe system shall provide a 2-1/2 inch hose connection for use primarily by trained personnel or by the fire department during initial response. This class has no hose attached. The fire department will usually carry hose packs to the floor level, typically a stairwell, where they will start their operations and connect to the standpipe system. These connections must match the hose thread utilized by the fire department.

Class II – A Class II standpipe system shall provide 1-1/2 inch hose stations to supply water for use primarily by trained personnel or by the fire department during initial response. These are typically found in cabinets with 100’ of hose.

Class III – A Class III standpipe system shall provide 1-1/2 inch hose stations to supply water for use by trained personnel and a 2-1/2 inch hose connection to supply a larger volume of water for use by fire departments and those trained in heavy fire streams. Many times these connections will provide a 2-1/2 inch reducer to a 1-1/2 hose connection.

Description

Stat-X® Condensed Aerosol Fire Suppression Systems

Optimum Engineers Ltd. proudly supplies, installs, and commissions the Stat-X® Condensed Aerosol Fire Suppression System, representing the pinnacle of advanced fire protection technology. Engineered to replace outdated, space-consuming gas and water-based systems, Stat-X® provides a compact, highly effective, and environmentally friendly solution for protecting your most critical industrial and commercial assets.

🔬 How Stat-X® Works: The Science of Suppression

Unlike traditional systems that extinguish fires by oxygen deprivation or cooling, Stat-X® operates at the molecular level. Upon activation, the non-pressurized solid compound undergoes a controlled combustion process, generating an ultra-fine, potassium-based aerosol.

Comprising 70% solid condensed particles and 30% carrier gases (primarily Nitrogen), this highly buoyant aerosol quickly floods the protected space. With a mean particulate diameter of just 1 to 2 microns, the potassium radicals (K) directly interact with the flame’s free radicals (OH, H, and O), chemically interrupting the combustion chain reaction and extinguishing the fire within seconds.

🌟 Key Features & Engineering Benefits

  • Superior Fire Knockdown: Highly effective against Class A (surface), Class B (flammable liquids), and Class C (energized electrical) fire hazards.

  • Zero Piping or Manifolds: Operates without the need for expensive pressure vessels, distribution piping networks, or complex nozzle alignments, significantly reducing installation time and costs.

  • Ultimate Space & Weight Savings: Offers up to a 90% reduction in weight and space footprint compared to conventional halocarbon or CO2 gas systems.

  • Unmatched Environmental Safety: Features Zero Ozone Depletion Potential (ODP), Zero Global Warming Potential (GWP), and zero atmospheric lifetime.

  • Personnel Safe: U.S. EPA SNAP listed as acceptable for use in normally occupied and unoccupied spaces at recommended design concentrations.

  • No Thermal Breakdown: Unlike HFC clean agents, the Stat-X® aerosol does not break down in the presence of extreme heat, ensuring no highly toxic or corrosive by-products (like hydrofluoric acid) are generated during a fire event.

  • Minimal Post-Fire Maintenance: The buoyant aerosol is easily vented out of the room post-discharge, and any minor settled particulate can be wiped clean with a simple water and vinegar solution, drastically reducing operational downtime.

🏭 Ideal Hazard Applications

Stat-X® is engineered to perform in challenging environments where space is at a premium and collateral water damage is unacceptable.

  • Electrical & Control Rooms: Switchgear rooms, MCCs, and critical power distribution centers.

  • Industrial Machinery: Inside CNC machines, robotic automation enclosures, and heavy manufacturing equipment.

  • Power Generation: Wind turbine nacelles, transformer cabinets, and gas turbine enclosures.

  • Telecommunications & Data: Server racks, telecom shelters, and battery energy storage systems (BESS).

  • Marine & Transportation: Engine rooms, locomotive power cars, and transit bus engine compartments.

🛡️ Global Certifications & Standards Compliance

Optimum Engineers Ltd. ensures every system is designed with strict adherence to the highest engineering codes and standards:

  • NFPA 2010: Standard on Aerosol Fire-Extinguishing Systems

  • UL / ULC Listed: Under UL 2775 for Fixed Condensed Aerosol Extinguishing System Units

  • U.S. EPA SNAP Listed: Approved substitute for halon and ozone-depleting chemicals

  • Marine Approvals: USCG Approved, ABS (American Bureau of Shipping), and BV (Bureau Veritas) Certified

  • EN 15276-1: European standard for condensed aerosol fire extinguishing systems
